description_en: Sets the security information management preferences for a directory
description_zh: 调用SetSecurityInfoPreference设置目录的安全信息管理偏好
name: SetSecurityInfoPreference

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow CloudSSO users in the directory to manage their security email addresses in the CloudSSO user portal. This includes setting, modifying, and deleting security email addresses, as well as sending verification emails. Valid values:

true: Allowed.
false: Not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许目录中的云SSO用户在云SSO用户门户自主管理安全邮箱（包括设置、修改、删除安全邮箱及发送验证邮件）。取值：

true：允许。
false：不允许
parameters.name: allow_user_manage_security_email

AllowUserManageSecurityEmail.description_en:
Indicates whether CloudSSO users in the directory are allowed to manage their security email addresses in the CloudSSO user portal. Valid values:

true: Allowed.
false: Not allowed
AllowUserManageSecurityEmail.description_zh:
是否允许目录中的云SSO用户在云SSO用户门户自主管理安全邮箱。取值：

true：允许。
false：不允许
AllowUserManageSecurityEmail.title_en: 是否允许用户自主管理安全邮箱
AllowUserManageSecurityEmail.title_zh: 是否允许用户自主管理安全邮箱
